user.title: Setup Atomberg Smart Lock
user.description: Choose how you want to add your lock:

menu_options.native: Native Bluetooth Pairing (Zero-Snoop, recommended for new/reset locks)
menu_options.cloud: Sync from Atomberg Account (import already-paired locks from app)
menu_options.manual: Manual Key Entry (for users with existing MAC, Key, and Salt)

native.title: Native Bluetooth Pairing
native.description: Put your Atomberg lock in pairing mode (press the setup button on the lock), select it from the list below, and Home Assistant will securely pair with it directly.

cloud.title: Atomberg Cloud Account Sync
cloud.description: Sign in to your Atomberg account (supports Email, Google, Apple, or Facebook) and paste the redirected URL or authorization code below to import your locks.

data.auth_code: Redirect URL or Authorization Code / Token

manual.title: Manual Key Entry
manual.description: Enter your lock's Bluetooth MAC address, 16-byte Master Key, and 4-byte Lock Salt.

error.pairing_failed: Failed to pair with lock over Bluetooth. Make sure the lock is in pairing mode and within range.
error.cloud_sync_failed: Failed to retrieve lock credentials from Atomberg account.
error.no_locks_found: No smart locks were found associated with this Atomberg account.

abort.already_configured: This Atomberg lock is already configured.

init.title: User Slot Mappings
init.description: Assign user-friendly names to registered fingerprint and NFC card slot IDs.
